transcript.text: I need to flag something critical before we go any further. During my inspection this morning, I found that the Bay 2 crane brake lining is at 18% remaining. Our maintenance standard requires immediate removal from service when brake lining drops below 20%. This means the crane should not be operating right now. The repair itself is a 6-hour brake replacement, but after that we also have to perform a 125% rated-capacity proof-load test before the crane can return to service. I haven't entered this finding in the maintenance system yet, but given that we have finished frames staged in Bay 2 and more arriving, I felt I had to bring this to the group immediately.
